approvedExceptions.reason: Camera's public capture, share, greatest-hits, and slideshow surfaces already consume the substantive GDS public contracts directly: PublicFlowShell (via CaptureStageShell), PublicShell, and PlaybackSurface. The granular per-stage widgets named in the 3.4.3-era issue #76 do not carry a usable contract in @sovereignsquad/gds-core 3.9.0: PublicIdentityStep/PublicCtaStep/PublicConsentStep/PublicAcceptStep/PublicRestartStep are thin `<Stack gap="md">{children}</Stack>` body-slot wrappers that only duplicate the Stack CaptureStageShell already applies; ShareButtonGroup/PublicShareOverlay cannot express ShareOverlay's copy/social/status orchestration; AccessRecoveryPanel does not fit the greatest-hits gallery (name coincidence); PlaybackControls duplicates the already-adopted PlaybackSurface framing for the runtime-exception slideshow player.
allowedImplementation: Bespoke Mantine field/validation/consent/action markup inside the official PublicFlowShell body
Custom share orchestration and slideshow controls inside the adopted GDS shells
mustStillUse: Accessible labels, visible focus, and explicit error/empty states
mustNotDo: Introduce a second public shell system
Wrap bodies in empty step primitives solely to claim coverage
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Adopt a granular public step/share/playback-control primitive only when the package ships one that carries this surface's real contract (fields/validation/actions/controls), not a bare layout wrapper.

approvedExceptions.reason: Published @sovereignsquad/gds-core 3.9.0 (the only published version) exports no Tour/Spotlight/Coachmark/Walkthrough contract. Its closest near-misses are the wrong shape: GdsWizardStepper is an inline form wizard with no overlay/targeting concept, and the only exported overlay-positioning primitive, Tooltip, is a plain hover-triggered label -- the wrong shape for a controlled, keyboard-driven, multi-step spotlight tour used on both the admin panel and the public capture flow.
allowedImplementation: Custom full-viewport spotlight/backdrop rendering, measured against real DOM targets via getBoundingClientRect()
Custom fixed-position tooltip placement math (no Floating UI/Popover dependency needed for v1)
Custom step-sequencing state and localStorage persistence
mustStillUse: OverlayManagerProvider registration for stacking/collision behavior with other overlays
GDS-approved Button/Text/Stack/Group primitives (via components/gds/PublicPrimitives.tsx) for tour controls
data-tour-id targets on real, already GDS-composed elements -- never a parallel UI
mustNotDo: Introduce a second overlay/modal stack that bypasses OverlayManagerProvider
Reuse the tour's spotlight styling as a general-purpose overlay pattern for unrelated features
a11yRequirements: Focus trap within the active tooltip while a tour step is open
Full keyboard operation: Tab cycles within the tooltip, Enter/Space activates the focused control, Escape exits the tour
aria-live polite announcement of each step's title on change
Focus returns to the pre-tour element on exit
testingRequirements: Manual QA per admin role (global admin, partner-only admin) verifying step filtering
Manual QA for the capture flow with single-frame and multi-frame events
Manual keyboard-only walkthrough of both tours
observabilityRequirements: Emit a GDS telemetry event (GdsTelemetryProvider) on tour start/step/skip/complete
console.error and auto-skip a step whose target cannot be found in the DOM
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Replace the custom spotlight/backdrop and step engine when @sovereignsquad/gds-core publishes a Tour/Spotlight contract.
